enabledPlatforms.title: Platforms that may affect the timer
enabledPlatforms.description: Choose live platforms plus Streamlabs or Ko-fi if their Streamer.bot integrations should affect the timer.

autoStartWhenLive.title: Start the timer automatically when a stream goes live

pauseWhenOffline.title: Pause the timer when every selected platform is offline

resetToStartingMinutesOnStreamOnline.title: Reset to the starting time when a new stream session begins

allowSimulatedEvents.title: Allow Streamer.bot test events to change the timer
allowSimulatedEvents.description: Leave disabled for production. Enable only while deliberately testing timer awards.

enableModeratorCommands.title: Enable moderator and broadcaster timer control commands

defaultManualAddSeconds.title: Default seconds added when the add-time command gets no argument

giftSecondsEach.title: Seconds added per engagement gift unit
giftSecondsEach.description: Useful for TikTok and other gift-style alerts that expose a positive quantity.

cheerBitsThreshold.title: Bits or Power-Up threshold
cheerBitsThreshold.description: Bits accumulate for the stream session. Each completed threshold can add time.

cheerThresholdAwardSeconds.title: Seconds added per completed Bits threshold
cheerThresholdAwardSeconds.description: Set to 0 to track Bits without changing the timer.

financialCurrency.title: Currency accepted for donation and purchase bonuses
financialCurrency.description: Three-letter currency code. Other currencies are ignored because StreamBridge does not perform currency conversion.

requireVerifiedFinancialEvents.title: Require a stable provider ID for financial bonuses
requireVerifiedFinancialEvents.description: Recommended. Unverified donations and purchases may still display as alerts but cannot alter the timer.

donationSecondsPerWholeUnit.title: Seconds per whole donation currency unit
donationSecondsPerWholeUnit.description: Example: 60 adds one minute per whole USD when the selected currency is USD. Set to 0 to disable.

purchaseSecondsPerWholeUnit.title: Seconds per whole purchase currency unit
purchaseSecondsPerWholeUnit.description: Applies to Streamlabs merchandise and Ko-fi shop orders. Set to 0 to disable.

raidBaseSeconds.title: Base seconds added for a raid

raidPerViewerSeconds.title: Extra seconds added per raid viewer

minimumRaidViewers.title: Minimum raid viewers before the raid bonus applies

likeThreshold.title: TikTok-like threshold
likeThreshold.description: A bonus is added only when the total like counter crosses another full threshold. Example: 100 means 100, 200, 300, and so on.

likeThresholdAwardSeconds.title: Seconds added per completed like threshold

hypeTrainLevelSeconds.title: Seconds per new Hype Train level
hypeTrainLevelSeconds.description: The same Hype Train level is counted once even when Streamer.bot sends multiple update events. Set to 0 to disable.

watchStreakSeconds.title: Seconds per Twitch Watch Streak event
watchStreakSeconds.description: Set to 0 to track without changing the timer.

modiversarySecondsPerMonth.title: Seconds per Modiversary month
modiversarySecondsPerMonth.description: Multiplied by the reported month count. Set to 0 to disable.

showOverlay.title: Publish timer state to the add-on overlay broker
